notes: Signing in works again. The QR code and activation code sat below the bottom edge of the screen with no way to scroll to them, so sign-in could not be completed; the screen is now laid out across instead of down and shrinks to fit any television. twitch.tv/activate is easy to read next to the QR code again, and the QR stays sharp at any size. Start-up is sturdier: the theme no longer loads during the first frame, and unreadable settings or a lost sign-in are now cleared and recovered from instead of stopping the app.
